name: prep-web
description: Prep! practice-room prototype rebuilt with HTML, Node.js and Tailwind CSS (Playful Geometric style).

scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run build:css
scripts.dev: npm run assets && concurrently -k -n css,web -c magenta,cyan "tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./public/css/styles.css --watch" "node server.js"
